messages.subject: CPD seminar: Sentencing in health & safety and corporate manslaughter cases
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleagues,

Our next CPD seminar, 'Recent trends in sentencing for health & safety offences', takes place on 30 April at 12:30 in the Bishopsgate training suite (lunch provided, 1 CPD hour). External speaker: a recorder sitting in the Crown Court. Register via the L&D portal.

Knowledge & Learning Team
